searchText: Anyone been thinking about implementing secret shared validator clients? You could for example run 3 instances of it (across 3 different machines) and require 2 of 3 to sign a message, for such a message to be valid. Basically like multisig There is some work being done by one team. Looking for the name (Apart from PlatON ;)) yup! that's it.. Not that I know of. I'd love to see more experimentation here though Ok. Wondering how much any of the existing client or staking teams know about it I'm looking to add this to walletd (https://github.com/wealdtech/walletd) some time soon.
